question: Should OpenClaw add a public sub-agent pre-timeout warning contract, and should it be global config, a per-`sessions_spawn` override, or both?
rationale: The missing behavior is visible in source, but choosing public config/tool semantics and cross-runtime warning delivery is a product/API decision that automation should not pick alone.

options.title: Add global plus per-spawn controls
options.body: Expose a documented default plus a per-spawn override, schedule a child-visible warning before hard timeout, and test native plus ACP behavior.

options.title: Add only a global default
options.body: Keep the tool API smaller by configuring the grace period only under sub-agent defaults, at the cost of less per-task control.

options.title: Defer to post-timeout recovery
options.body: Keep the current hard-timeout and recovery model if maintainers do not want child-visible timeout warnings in the core lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Add global plus per-spawn controls
recommendation.body: Expose a documented default plus a per-spawn override, schedule a child-visible warning before hard timeout, and test native plus ACP behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest combined prior review and feature-history signal across subagent lifecycle, ACP spawn, and timeout/announce behavior.
